text: AI is changing the workplace in many ways. One big change is automation. Machines and software can now do repetitive tasks, such as sorting data or answering simple customer questions. This saves time and reduces mistakes. There are also many productivity tools that help workers plan their day, write emails faster, or organise meetings. Instead of replacing people, AI often works together with humans. For example, doctors use AI to check X-rays, but they still make the final decision. However, some jobs are changing or disappearing, so workers need to learn new skills. In short, AI brings both opportunities and challenges to modern work.
